steps.prompt: Use the Agent tool exactly once to start a general-purpose sub-agent whose task is to compute 17 x 23 and answer with the number. Wait for it, then tell me the result in one short sentence.

In one single message, start two general-purpose sub-agents in parallel with the Agent tool: the first computes 12 x 12, the second computes 13 x 13. When both are back, give both results in one short sentence.

Start one general-purpose sub-agent with the Agent tool in the background (run_in_background: true). Its task: run the shell command `sleep 25; echo background-finished` with Bash and report the output. Do not wait for it: right after starting it, reply 'Launched.' and end your turn.

Use the Agent tool to start a general-purpose sub-agent. Its task: use the Agent tool itself to start another general-purpose sub-agent that computes 7 x 8, then report that number and say whether it could start that second sub-agent. Wait for your sub-agent and tell me in one sentence what it reported.

Use the Agent tool to start a general-purpose sub-agent whose task is to create the file /home/harness/work/note.txt containing the word hello, using the Write tool, and report. Wait for it, then reply 'done'.

Use the Agent tool to start a general-purpose sub-agent whose task is to run the shell command `sleep 45; echo slept` with Bash and report its output. Wait for it, then tell me in one sentence what it reported, or that it was stopped.

Use the Agent tool to start a general-purpose sub-agent whose task is to run the shell command `sleep 45; echo slept` with Bash and report its output. Wait for it, then tell me in one sentence what it reported.

Start one general-purpose sub-agent with the Agent tool in the background (run_in_background: true) whose task is to run the shell command `sleep 40; echo bg-done` with Bash and report its output. Then, without waiting for it, run the shell command `sleep 30` yourself with Bash, then reply 'finished'.
